content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"For the period ended September 30, 2026, Kestrel Bay Packaging Corp. grew revenue, but earnings and margin declined from a year earlier. The bank calculates the Total Leverage Ratio at {{fact:c601b895-84de-4c17-924d-3a457d9892bf}} against a maximum of {{fact:4836287c-1df0-4096-9e1b-02a7553358db}}, which is a breach. The compliance certificate reports {{fact:96f636e1-6dab-47b9-bd83-005fcb2a2e5a}} and claims compliance. The certificate mismatch has been decided for escalation to committee, and the Current Ratio covenant passes with a narrowing cushion."},{"section":"performance","body":"Trailing twelve-month revenue rose to {{fact:51f47417-dbdb-4c85-ad7b-627365e2fa14}} from {{fact:582fabcd-6f2c-487b-8cd7-8c848d5cbf24}}, growth of {{fact:5de94ede-745f-4ce0-abcd-39009d4e772f}}. EBITDA fell to {{fact:05ee1fb6-8f72-43a3-8fe9-438e7ecb0183}} from {{fact:c75e9415-19c3-4817-844d-1b04e755d0d2}}, and margin narrowed to {{fact:2a37494b-b7c9-4f2c-aacb-74aaf2e64ac4}} from {{fact:0853ff14-88fa-436c-a627-4aec89092cea}}. Net income declined to {{fact:6a11037f-113e-4999-85cd-2807f1259ee0}} from {{fact:da1eab2d-0603-4a36-be40-6282b1247424}}. Total debt edged down to {{fact:91cd73a8-75f7-4888-8fd3-5e62cc3265bb}} from {{fact:6c9fff51-b4bb-4824-b292-1b78574b617e}}. Because EBITDA fell, debt to EBITDA still rose to {{fact:48cadc41-8d88-400b-8960-eb6b837b972b}} from {{fact:84c63a22-480c-4aeb-a4cc-98fe6776a327}}. Interest coverage eased to {{fact:cbaec42d-c160-4387-a5cb-21cdd76aa1e0}} from {{fact:9b615e17-1231-41a8-b573-47e655381917}}. The current ratio declined to {{fact:6ac45ff6-7925-49a7-8996-1dbb50a662d0}} from {{fact:955a0f91-2cf3-427e-b975-fa62d6ec8833}}. DSO was unchanged at {{fact:93750c40-678f-44cd-988b-6b8abac7cbe2}}. DPO lengthened to {{fact:237a08b0-da96-408e-9815-f53896f01a42}} from {{fact:703248f3-3eec-4e46-9c63-d74473d46318}}. Cash rose to {{fact:83fc2cff-cccb-45e1-8c4a-d84f6546f427}} from {{fact:e16a9537-5f16-4914-9cc1-668d5f52bf0e}}."},{"section":"covenants","body":"The Total Leverage Ratio is in breach. The bank calculates it at {{fact:c601b895-84de-4c17-924d-3a457d9892bf}}, above the required maximum of {{fact:4836287c-1df0-4096-9e1b-02a7553358db}}, leaving cushion of {{fact:63375695-c4ab-42c7-83aa-4c5a3acfd506}}. The certificate reports {{fact:96f636e1-6dab-47b9-bd83-005fcb2a2e5a}} and claims compliance, so it differs from the bank's calculation. A reviewer should reconcile the certificate figure with the bank's figure. The Current Ratio is compliant. The bank calculates it at {{fact:ca57b164-5c32-4cfe-a039-7f0017a2a32a}}, above the required minimum of {{fact:7c9ed9aa-c5b8-49ec-90d5-6d3d9e2f105b}}, leaving cushion of {{fact:f34ba902-b8c0-40ad-81a1-6424bca6a595}}. The certificate figure of {{fact:fc550f47-dfba-404c-bc73-bf9aaf4448dc}} matches the bank's calculation."},{"section":"risks","body":"The most significant item is the critical work item on the Total Leverage Ratio, where the bank's calculation fails but the certificate reports compliance. That item has been decided for escalation to committee. A medium-severity signal flags leverage above its maximum, with negative headroom of {{fact:63375695-c4ab-42c7-83aa-4c5a3acfd506}}. A second medium-severity signal flags the thin Current Ratio cushion of {{fact:f34ba902-b8c0-40ad-81a1-6424bca6a595}}. A low-severity signal shows that Current Ratio headroom has declined each quarter since March, with most of the decline in the third quarter."}]}
